device.description: 12-bit 750 kSPS dual simultaneous-sampling SAR ADC, pseudo-differential inputs, SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: ads8350.pdf (SBAS580D, ADS8350/ADS7850/ADS7250) p.3 pin configuration and functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.5 electrical characteristics (DVDD 1.65-5.5 V), p.9 timing requirements, switching characteristics and Figure 1, p.23 Table 1 transfer characteristics, p.24 serial interface (Figure 52, Table 2 data launch edge), p.25 short-cycling / frame abort

pages: p.3 (pin configuration and functions), p.4 (ROC: AVDD 5 V nom, DVDD 3.3 V nom), p.5 (electrical characteristics: DVDD 1.65-5.5 V, VIH/VIL), p.9 (timing requirements, switching characteristics: tCONV 590 ns, tDV_CSDO 12 ns, tDZ_CSDO 10 ns, tD_CKDO 20 ns; Figure 1), p.23 (Table 1 transfer characteristics, twos complement), p.24 (serial interface, Figure 52, Table 2), p.25 (frame abort)
notModeled: analog inputs and references: every conversion returns the 0 V (AINP_x - AINM_x = 0) code, twos complement 0
channel B: both ADCs sample simultaneously but only SDO-A (ADC_A result) is modeled; SDO-B (ADC_B result, same frame) is never driven
the conversion runs during SCLK 1-14 after CS falls (tCONV 590 ns max); the result is the constant 0 V code, so it is not tied to the SCLK count

frame abort / short-cycling: CS high before the 15th SCLK falling edge aborts the conversion; CS high later aborts the transfer (tPH_CS_SHRT); the minimum 27 SCLK falling edges per frame are not checked
throughput, acquisition time and SCLK frequency limits (24 MHz max)
the timing diagram's SCLK idles high; data launch on SCLK falling edges (Table 2), the host reads on the following falling edge (mode 2)
variants: ADS8350 (16-bit), ADS7850 (14-bit) and ADS7250 (12-bit) share ads8350.pdf: same pinout and frame (15 zeros, then the result MSB first, zero fill); own spec each. ADS8355 (ads8355.pdf) is the later register-programmable 1 MSPS version.
